correctness.rationale: The four-point exhaustion combines the source's affine-cone singular-locus computation with a complete gcd-stratum analysis of P(2,6,7,9). At the two smooth-stack quotient points, tangent representations give 1/2(1,1) and 1/3(1,2). At P_x, an equivariant A1 normal form and its C2 uniformization give the order-four action 1/4(1,3). At P_t, an invariant analytic coordinate change gives an A2 cover; combining its mu3 deck action with the lifted residual mu7 action gives a cyclic order-21 action equivalent to 1/21(1,8). The HJ chain, canonical index, discrepancy vector, and total exceptional-curve count are exact consequences.

value.rationale: X_18 is the unique surface attaining the new sharp stable-pair volume bound, so its complete singularity basket is a natural structural invariant rather than an arbitrary slice. The result isolates the unique noncanonical surface singularity, determines its index, minimal-resolution chain, and discrepancies, and gives the full nine-curve exceptional configuration. These data are directly relevant to resolution, orbifold intersection theory, and future deformation analysis of the extremal example.
